answer: Each identity posts one offer on the shale board, locking 80 and paying 12 credits to list. A river relay delivers the claim, and weight counts only after the taker accepts delivery. The vertex panel recomputes each acceptance, and a missed delivery burns the bond to the taker. Each proven taker takes at most two offers per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 500 takers. A rented-taker ring fails because a taker counts only if it delivered itself in a prior epoch. The k-th fake still pays 80 plus 12 plus 30, so 1,000 fakes cost 122,000 credits; an honest identity pays once and recovers its bond.
